column1: # Exploratory; not a test of H1-H10.

column3: never accuracy.

column1: # 90% intervals. Method per row by r3-P30's interval-choice.csv (the row of the largest simulated count at or below the row's creator count; where no method holds there
column2: a reading is at most undetermined); cohort ratios carry a creator-cluster bootstrap percentile interval
column3: a class r3-P30 did not calibrate.

column1: # Half-effect disclosure (56 primaries): if every true effect sat at half its margin
column2: about 2.8 readings A would be expected at the deposited 5%
column3: up to about 6.1 for the share
column5: AUC and rank-correlation classes (r3-P30's readings table); a reading A is never called a finding.

column1: # Margins (deposit 2): H1 a log ratio of 0.223 (ratio 0.80 to 1.25); H4 0.20 between-creator SD; H6 OE 5 points (a difference in shares); H6 log MH 0.223. Named directions: H1 negative (claimed slower)
column2: H4 positive (fewer contractions in the claimed voice)
column3: H6 negative (fewer claimed asks).

column1: # Seen creators only; English-only recognizer (1

column3: an XT and an R0 value); the ST rows on its creators with own-voice-only recordings. Creator counts 1 to 4 from a creator count printed elsewhere (deposit 2
column6: the programme's fixed counts) or earlier in these entries are stated against it ('all but fewer than 5 of N'
column7: 'N and fewer than 5 more'): N is used as a bound
column8: not as a claim that the groups are nested.

column1: # Rows of r3-P04 (position-matched contrasts
column3: span-structure transplants); the forest figure's data. XT: cross-creator transplant matched on format and length band; ST: same-creator transplant onto own-voice-only recordings with a shift of up to half a tenth; R0: the registered within-recording run permutation
column4: a benchmark known not to be centred (MR-18d). Where a row's creator count is banded or withheld
column5: the method is given as r3-P30's choice at the row's count
column6: without its name (the lead's step-1 decision 53(a)). Values that could narrow a banded count are not printed (the lead's step-1 decision 62).
